content.stem: (audio) How long will the tour last?

transcript.speaker: N
transcript.text: Thank you for joining the Old Town Walking Tour. The tour will last about two hours and covers three historical temples and a traditional shopping street. Please follow your guide and be careful when crossing the streets. At the end of the tour, you will receive a coupon for a free drink at a local café. We hope you enjoy learning about the history of our city.

content.rationale: The tour lasts about two hours.
